items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL — NVIDIA's open 120B vision model for agents
items.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is NVIDIA's open 120B vision-language MoE with 12B active parameters and a 1M-token context. It shipped on 2026-10-15 with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B, a 2-bit model that fits in 24GB.

explainer.tagline: NVIDIA's new open model reads text, documents, charts and short videos in one checkpoint, with only 12B parameters active per token.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 — an in-place upgrade with stronger agent scores
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is a new checkpoint of DeepSeek's open-weight Flash model.

explainer.tagline: DeepSeek swaps a better-trained checkpoint into deepseek-flash: higher agent and coding scores, shorter outputs, same price.

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein — Black Forest Labs' 5.6B open-weights image model
items.summary: FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6B open-weights model from Black Forest Labs.

explainer.tagline: A small open-weights FLUX 3 model that makes, edits and combines images on a consumer GPU.

items.title: Muse Spark Open — Meta's 816B open-weight model for coding and agents
items.summary: Muse Spark Open is Meta's new open-weight Muse model.

explainer.tagline: Meta puts an 816B Muse model with a 1M-token context into open weights, sized to run on two Mac Studios.
